title: validation.v1
description: One validation record (VAL.1 BP3, BP4): where the release candidate was deployed, which commit, and the result of every scenario run against it, added to <qf validation_records_dir>/<version>.yaml by the release pull request. write_validation_record_tool fills in the automated results; the person who ran a guided demo or a trial use enters its result. That the record's release is proposed, that the deployed commit is the release's, that every result names an existing scenario, that every automated scenario and every affected wish has a result and that none failed are rules of verify_release_evidence_gate and verify_acceptance_to_wishes_link_gate, not of this schema.

version.description: The release this record validates, as its release record names it (e.g. 1.4.0).

environment.description: Where the scenarios ran: an environment close to the customer's (e.g. staging), and the commit deployed there.

commit.description: The full SHA of the deployed commit.

technique.description: How it ran, as the plan's validation section names it (e.g. acceptance test, guided demo, trial use).

note.description: What was observed, in the customer's terms; required in practice for a failure.
